species.name: Leafing
species.description:
LEAFING hides among fallen leaves to
nap in the sun. The leaf on its head
hardens a little each time it battles,
until the edge shines like metal.

species.name: Erobi
species.description: Erobi is a cheerful regional bird Pokémon known for the bright yellow feathers covering its face. The black smiley markings on its face look as if they were drawn on with a marker, and they help it appear friendly to both people and Pokémon. Even when startled, Erobi keeps its painted smile, making it difficult to tell what it is really thinking.

design.body_shape: an upright body on two legs with a tail
